blocks.x: As an avid adventurer and a travel editor, I’ve stayed at several IHG properties over the years—and there are plenty more on my bucket list (I mean, have you seen the Six Senses Bhutan?!). The chain—which owns 20 unique hotel brands, from InterContinental and Regent to Iberostar and Holiday Inn—operates more than 6,600 properties around the world, and IHG One Rewards is one of my favorite loyalty programs out there, in no small part for their exclusive rates and late check-outs.

If you’re looking for a place to stay on an upcoming trip—or even just looking for a reason to book a trip in the first place—a scroll through IHG’s properties will do you good. And if you’re looking to save a little moolah on accommodations so you can spend a little more on good food and shopping on vacation, the best IHG deals and discounts available right now are your ticket to doing so.
Save 55% at IHG without a discount code by booking in advance

Good news for anyone planning a beach vacation in the near future: Now through November 15, 2026, you can save 55% on bookings at select Iberostar Beachfront Resorts (an IHG hotel brand) in Aruba, Brazil, Jamaica, Mexico, Dominican Republic, and Miami for stays from March 1, 2027, through August 31, 2027. No promo code is required—just look at the offer page to see what properties are up for grabs. Start daydreaming about the sun and sand!
Save up to 20% at IHG without a promo code when you book a last-minute weekend trip

It pays to procrastinate—at least when it comes to IHG hotel bookings! IHG One Rewards members save up to 20% (non-members save 15%) when they book a stay up to three days in advance at select properties across participating hotels at all 20 of IHG’s brands. These stays must fall on a Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, with a one-night minimum. This discount applies to the Best Flexible Rate at properties in the US, Canada, Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean​. Just note that the bookings must be prepaid and are non-refundable.
Unlock member-only rates through IHG One Rewards without a coupon code

It’s always better to be on the other side of the velvet rope, and with IHG One Rewards, you get exclusive access to member rates and deals that aren’t available to the general public, points towards free future nights, complimentary Wi-Fi, late check-out, and so much more. The best part? Joining is totally free—and actually easy.
Score at least 5% off with the IHG military discount

If you or one of your family members served in the military, IHG wants to say thank you by offering at least 5% off the Best Flexible Rate on its site. US and Canadian active-duty members, veterans, retired military members, and military family members can receive the discount by selecting the "Military Appreciation Leisure Rate" when booking leisure trips, then presenting a valid military or veteran ID at the time of check-in. The discount rate varies by hotel, so be sure to look into the offerings for the property of your choice.
Embrace retirement with the senior discount

Age is a gift—and IHG is upping the ante with a senior discount for IHG One Rewards members who are 62 years of age or older. Just use the "Senior Discount" option in the rate preference dropdown while searching, and find discounted rates that vary by hotel, length of stay, and time of booking. Ready to lock down plans early? IHG One Rewards members who book stays more than three days in advance can take advantage of the Member Senior Advance Purchase Discount rate and save even more.
Access special member rates with your AAA discount

AAA members can drive away with a darn good discount when booking IHG properties using the AAA​ Member Rate. That’s right, AAA members get access to exclusive lowered room rates at participating hotels—just select the AAA Member Rate during the online booking process, and be sure to bring your membership card and present it upon arrival at the hotel. It sounds like a road trip might be in your future!
What to do if your IHG discount code isn’t working

If your IHG promo code isn't working at checkout, don't panic. You can troubleshoot by double-checking that your code is spelled correctly and that there are no extra spaces or typos. You can also check the details of the promo code to ensure it's still active and hasn't expired. Some discount codes have a minimum spend requirement, too, so make sure your cart meets any necessary criteria to qualify. If all else fails, clear your browser's cache and give the page a refresh—it might just be a technical issue!
